mapper.sql: post_id, author_id, category_id, title, summary, content, thumbnail_url, view_count, is_notice AS notice, status, published_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts (author_id, category_id, title, summary, content, thumbnail_url, view_count, is_notice, status, published_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{authorId}, #{categoryId}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{content}, #{thumbnailUrl}, #{viewCount}, #{notice}, #{status}, #{publishedAt}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE posts SET category_id=#{categoryId}, title=#{title}, summary=#{summary}, content=#{content}, thumbnail_url=#{thumbnailUrl}, view_count=#{viewCount}, is_notice=#{notice}, status=#{status}, published_at=#{publishedAt}, deleted_at=#{deletedAt}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE post_id=#{postId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS post_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'PUBLISHED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS published_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'DRAFT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS draft_count, COALESCE(SUM(rr.distance_km), 0) AS total_distance_km, COALESCE(SUM(rr.duration_seconds), 0) AS total_duration_seconds FROM posts p LEFT JOIN running_records rr ON rr.post_id = p.post_id WHERE p.author_id = #{authorId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status IN ('PUBLISHED', 'DRAFT')

SELECT p.post_id, category.name AS category_name, p.title, p.summary, p.status, p.published_at, p.created_at, (SELECT pi.storage_key FROM post_images pi WHERE pi.post_id = p.post_id ORDER BY pi.display_order, pi.image_id LIMIT 1) AS storage_key, rr.distance_km, rr.duration_seconds, rr.region, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_likes pl WHERE pl.post_id = p.post_id) AS like_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.post_id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL) AS comment_count FROM posts p JOIN categories category ON category.category_id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN running_records rr ON rr.post_id = p.post_id
ORDER BY
COALESCE(p.published_at, p.created_at) ASC, p.post_id ASC COALESCE(p.published_at, p.created_at) DESC, p.post_id DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
